title: Listening Drill — School weather project — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: School weather project — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on school weather project. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Monday. The group will now meet on Tuesday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the science stairs; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is reading sheets. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow forty minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check screen height before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed weather record so we can offer feedback.
